messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika.rao@midscope.com>, Tom Beckett <t.beckett@midscope.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps — platform evaluation (security evidence & buying process)

Hi Anika & Tom,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about Midscope’s integration needs and the buying timeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned: 

- What we heard: you care most about predictable latency for inference across mixed model sizes, data residency for PHI, and an auditable evidence package (SOC 2 + penetration test summary + sample audit logs) for procurement.
- Initial timeline: procurement + legal review targeted for late Oct, pilot decision in early Nov. Economic buyer: Tom (confirmed); technical evaluator: Anika; security reviewer: internal security team (we agreed to loop in), procurement lead TBD.

Action items (owner / ETA):
1) Sofia — deliver an evidence bundle (SOC 2 summary, pen-test highlights, retention policy sample) and an evidence tracker spreadsheet for your procurement team (EOD Wed).
2) Marcus — confirm model hosting & data residency options and list of compatible regions (EOD Thu).
3) Priyom — provide a short note on encryption, audit log examples, and where logs are retained (by Fri).
4) Anika/Tom — confirm procurement contact and whether a specific doc template is required.

I’ve attached the initial evidence artifacts we typically share (summaries, not full reports) and an editable evidence_tracker.xlsx so procurement can mark which items they need full copies of. If this looks right, I’ll set up a 30-min follow-up next week with our security lead + Marcus to go through the checklist.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf (summary, 2 pages); pen_test_summary.pdf (executive highlights); data-retention-policy.pdf (snippet); evidence_tracker.xlsx (template)

Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — platform evaluation (security evidence & buying process)

Thanks Sofia — I’m looping in Logan for regional hosting details (low-latency options) but a couple of quick clarifications for procurement: 

- Pen test: we can provide the executive summary and remediation tracker. Full reports are shared under NDA only — recommend asking procurement if they will sign a standard mutual NDA or need one of theirs.
- Audit logs: we can produce sample anonymized logs that show request/response IDs, timestamps, and user tokens (we truncate any PII). Need to confirm whether they require per-token content in logs for their audit.
- Data residency: Redwood Private can be deployed in a customer VPC in us-west-2 or eu-west-1; Dedicated pools can be restricted by region per contract.

Action for me: will prepare a brief one-pager on hosting/region options + a short matrix mapping features (KV cache, streaming, function calling) to possible latency implications. ETA: Thu COB.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Product — Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

Hi Anika / Tom — following up with the security evidence timeline and a few clarifications: 

- SOC 2: we are SOC 2 Type II; I’ve attached a 2-page SOC2_summary.pdf that highlights the scope and last audit date (Mar 2026). Full SOC 2 reports are provided under NDA (standard).
- Pen test: attached is pen_test_summary.pdf (exec highlights + high/medium findings that have been remediated). Full technical report is available under NDA.
- Audit logs & retention: we can produce anonymized sample logs and a document describing retention controls (see data-retention-policy.pdf). By default Redwood retains operational logs for 90 days; audit logs for 365 days by default for Dedicated/Private customers (configurable).

Deliverables we will provide once procurement confirms required artifacts: 
- An evidence_tracker.xlsx with checkboxes for each requested doc and a column for "full report under NDA".
- A sample anonymized audit log extract (CSV) and a short README explaining fields.
- Contact for security questionnaire: security@redwood.com (or I can join the next meeting).

If you send the procurement contact, we’ll add any template fields they want (e.g., specific control numbers or retention windows) to the tracker so procurement can mark acceptance quickly.

Thanks,

Priyom Das
Director, Governance & Compliance | Redwood Inference
